2026So Far: The Foreman Holds Serve, and Sleon1000 Climbs Back to EvenIn progress · 9 weeks in · dahlilama 15-3, Birdgangflyeagles 13-5, Goldminers1 12-6

Nine weeks in, dahlilama won by the biggest margin of the week and is still two games clear. Sleon1000 posted the top score and is back to .500, and Week 9's median line was decided by seven hundredths of a point. The evidence so far.

The foreman holds serve

dahlilama beat Bjspjs4 130.80–73.72. That 57.08-point margin was the biggest of the week, and 130.80 was the week's second-best score, so it was another 2-0 week. He's 15-3 with four straight head-to-head wins, still two games ahead of Birdgangflyeagles, and leads the league in points (1,168, about 37 ahead of Goldminers1). He's still the futures favorite at +150.

Sleon1000 is back to even

Sleon1000 dropped 142.28, the top score of Week 9, and beat elysianbeer by 47.96. That's four straight head-to-head wins after an 0-5 start, and a 2-0 week that took him from 7-9 to 9-9. It was his fourth weekly high score since 2023. The futures market noticed: he's now second at +700.

Seven hundredths of a point

The Week 9 median landed at 94.39, and two managers sat right on top of it. Birdgangflyeagles beat kevinnguu 96.04–94.46, the closest game of the week at 1.58 points. That snapped Birdgangflyeagles' two-game head-to-head skid, and with both scores above the median he went 2-0 to reach 13-5. kevinnguu cleared the median by 0.07, so he still split the week and is 10-8.

elysianbeer wasn't so lucky. His 94.32 missed the median by 0.07, so the loss to Sleon1000 made it an 0-2 week. He drops to 10-8.

Goldminers1 keeps pace

Goldminers1 beat showmeyourtd23 125.28–85.94, his second straight head-to-head win and another 2-0 week. He's 12-6, one game behind Birdgangflyeagles, and second in the league in points (1,131).

Three-way tie at 10-8

juleon8 beat rbanuelos3 85.98–81.06 in the week's lowest-scoring game. 85.98 was below the median, so it counted as a lucky win and a 1-1 week. That leaves juleon8, kevinnguu and elysianbeer all at 10-8. juleon8 still has the fewest points against in the league (821) and sits at +1,000 in the futures, level with Birdgangflyeagles.

Also in the file

  • MayockJr beat giJ03 109.66–92.20 and went 2-0. He's 8-10 and still leads the league with 43 moves.
  • No trades in Week 9. Bjspjs4 stays at seven for the year, but his 73.72 was the week's low score and he's 7-11.
  • rbanuelos3 has lost five straight head-to-head and is 6-12.
  • giJ03 has also lost five straight head-to-head and is 4-14, level with showmeyourtd23 at the bottom of the table.

cases.dahlilama: 2023 champ, 2025 runner-up and Points King, 4-1 all-time in the playoffs. 15-3, two games clear, and leads the league in points.
cases.Sleon1000: Best all-time record (26-16) and two straight #1 seeds, but 0-2 in the playoffs. Back to 9-9 after four straight head-to-head wins.
cases.Birdgangflyeagles: 13-5 after snapping a two-game head-to-head skid by 1.58 points. Has been a 1 seed and a last-place team. No middle gear.
cases.juleon8: Owns the league-record 11-game head-to-head win streak, snapped by 1.82 points in Week 4. Went from 1-5 to the 3 seed last year.
cases.rbanuelos3: Owns the season points record (1,858) and the highest score ever (180.24). Two playoff trips, no ring, and 6-12 after five straight head-to-head losses.
cases.kevinnguu: Rookie. 122.86 in his debut, and his first head-to-head win came against the futures favorite.
cases.Goldminers1: Four seasons, no playoff trips yet, and a league-record 10 weekly low scores. Also second in the league in points after a 175.08 and a 144.32.
cases.elysianbeer: Dropped 152.58 in Week 4, the top score of that week. 10-8 after missing the Week 9 median by 0.07. Still paying off last October's trade.
cases.MayockJr: The league's busiest manager. 61 moves last year turned a 7-7 team into a third-place finish.
cases.giJ03: Rookie, 4-14, and his Week 2 55.74 is already on the all-time low-score list. The field.
cases.showmeyourtd23: Reached the first title game without making a trade. Hasn't made the playoffs since.
cases.Bjspjs4: 7-11 with seven trades already, drafting from slot 8, the slot that's won all three titles. The 17-25 career mark is why the number's this long.
